post.description: Creates a new user account and sends an email confirmation link.

get.description: Validates the confirmation token and marks the user's email as confirmed.

post.description: Resends the email confirmation link. No-op if the email is already confirmed or does not exist.

204.description: Confirmation email sent (or silently skipped if already confirmed)

post.description: Authenticates a confirmed user and returns an access + refresh token pair.
Issues a new access + refresh token pair using a valid refresh token.

401.description: Invalid, expired, or reused refresh token

post.description: Sends a password reset email. No-op if the email is not registered.

204.description: Reset email sent (or silently skipped if email not found)

post.description: Resets the user password using a valid reset token.
Revokes all active refresh tokens for the authenticated user.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user's profile from the JWT payload.
Paginated listing of the caller's followed channels (per social-interactions/TD-05).

patch.description: Updates nickname, name, and/or description of the caller's own channel, rejecting with 409 when the requested nickname is already in use (per phase-04-video-channel-management/TD-04).

409.description: Requested nickname is already in use

get.description: Paginated listing of the caller's own channel videos across every status and visibility (per phase-04-video-channel-management/TD-05).
Returns a channel's public-facing fields (no user_id/email). `isSubscribed` is `false` unless the caller is authenticated (per social-interactions/TD-01).
Paginated listing of a channel's published, public videos (per phase-04-video-channel-management/TD-02, TD-05).

put.description: Sets the caller's follow state on a channel to the given value — idempotent, repeating the same request has no further effect (per social-interactions/TD-02, TD-03).

200.description: Current subscription state and updated subscriber count

409.description: Caller is the owner of this channel

put.summary: Set the caller subscription to a channel

get.description: Returns metadata for a published (public or unlisted) video, accessible anonymously, and increments its view count (per phase-05-video-watch-page/TD-01, TD-02). `currentUserReaction` is `null` unless the caller is authenticated (per social-interactions/TD-01).

404.description: Video not found, not ready, or not public/unlisted

get.description: Returns a short-lived presigned object-storage URL to stream a published (public or unlisted) video, accessible anonymously (per phase-05-video-watch-page/TD-01, phase-03-videos/TD-07).

404.description: Video not found, not ready, or not public/unlisted

get.description: Returns a short-lived presigned object-storage URL to download a published (public or unlisted) video, accessible anonymously (per phase-05-video-watch-page/TD-01, phase-03-videos/TD-07).

404.description: Video not found, not ready, or not public/unlisted

get.description: Returns up to `limit` ready+public videos from the anchor video's category, most recent first, excluding the anchor itself (per phase-05-video-watch-page/TD-03).

404.description: Anchor video not found, not ready, or not public/unlisted

put.description: Sets the caller's like/dislike state on a published video to the given value, or clears it when `type` is `null` — idempotent, repeating the same request has no further effect (per social-interactions/TD-01, TD-02, TD-03).

404.description: Video not found, not ready, or not public/unlisted

put.summary: Set the caller reaction to a video

get.description: Returns paginated top-level comments with embedded replies (depth 1) for a published video, readable anonymously; `currentUserReaction` is `null` unless the caller is authenticated (per social-interactions/TD-04).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max top-level comments to return (default 20, max 50)

404.description: Video not found, not ready, or not public/unlisted

post.description: Creates a top-level comment on a published video and increments its comment count (per social-interactions/TD-04).

404.description: Video not found, not ready, or not public/unlisted

post.summary: Post a top-level comment on a video

post.description: Creates a reply to a top-level comment, capped at a single level of depth — replying to a reply is rejected (per social-interactions/TD-04).

400.description: Validation error, or target comment is itself a reply

404.description: Video or target comment not found

post.summary: Reply to a top-level comment on a video

get.description: Returns the caller's own video with every owner-editable field, for the edit screen's initial load (per phase-04-video-channel-management SI-04.8b).

404.description: Video not found or not owned by the caller

patch.description: Updates title, description, category, and/or visibility of the caller's own video (per phase-04-video-channel-management/TD-01, TD-02).

404.description: Video not found or not owned by the caller

post.description: Applies the given fields and marks the video as published, requiring status "ready" (per phase-04-video-channel-management/TD-02).

400.description: Validation error, video not ready, or video has no title

404.description: Video not found or not owned by the caller

patch.description: Overwrites the auto-generated thumbnail with a custom upload (per phase-04-video-channel-management/TD-03).

400.description: Thumbnail file missing, not an accepted image type, or too large

404.description: Video not found or not owned by the caller

get.description: Returns a short-lived presigned object-storage URL to stream the caller's own ready video (per phase-03-videos/TD-07).

404.description: Video not found, not owned by the caller, or not ready

get.description: Returns a short-lived presigned object-storage URL to download the caller's own ready video (per phase-03-videos/TD-07).

404.description: Video not found, not owned by the caller, or not ready

put.description: Sets the caller's like/dislike state on a comment to the given value, or clears it when `type` is `null` — same idempotent contract as the video reaction endpoint (per social-interactions/TD-01, TD-02, TD-03).
